assign.request: Be the Servex mastermind: the systems architect who watches how the whole agent system runs (token use, spawn decisions, crashes, coordination) and makes it work better. Proposals page kept current here.

log.msg: First sweep: 136 claude processes held 27 GB; 1.5 GB of 31.7 GB free. Cause: Servex keeps every idle agent's process, and ~100 finished minions were idle (loose-ends alone spawned 53 audit minions in two minutes, past its 'waves of 20'). Stopped 68 finished loose-ends minions with stop_agent (session ids kept). Free memory back to 9.9 GB, 80 claude processes. Told all 14 task masterminds: stop each minion after reading its result, about 10 running at once. sub-mastermind skill gains that line with this evidence.
Usage at first sweep: 5-hour 19%, weekly 5% with about 12% of the week elapsed. Under pace by about 7 points.
The page-health log ai/health/<date>.jsonl does not exist for today: the health watcher is not writing. Nobody is told when a page breaks.

assistant-layers took all three points: sessions kept but processes stopped when idle (10 min for card agents, 15 for masterminds, 3 min for minions via a reaper in Servex/agents/Global.js), session ids minted at spawn, a cap of 12 live processes (SERVEX_AGENT_CAP) as one check inside servex-monitor's admit(). Proof on a private Servex on port 8190. I sent back a starvation case (a full cap of idle parents) and suggested admitting by free memory above 4 GB with a ceiling of about 30 instead of a fixed 12.

assistant-layers settled the admit rule: start while free memory >= 4 GB (SERVEX_MIN_FREE_MB) under a ceiling of 30 live processes (SERVEX_AGENT_CAP); a child of a live parent skips the ceiling but never the memory check, so parents cannot starve their children. The flat cap of 12 is recorded as the rejected alternative. Proven on the private Servex on 8190; goes live with the held restart.

The class uses the dev- prefix, which css-scopes gives to dev/DevBar; acceptable, same dev tier. Not covered: changes missed while the socket is disconnected (needs a server-side change counter).
